items.title: Monetary Policy Report—October 2026
items.summary: Inflation in Canada has been higher than anticipated and is projected to remain around 3% through much of 2027. It then returns close to 2% by the middle of 2028. The outlook for growth has improved, but uncertainty remains elevated.
items.why: deterministic: corroborated across feeds

items.title: Monetary Policy Report Press Conference Opening Statement
items.summary: Governor Tiff Macklem discusses the Monetary Policy Report and the key issues involved in the Governing Council’s deliberations about the monetary policy decision.
items.why: deterministic: corroborated across feeds

items.title: Minutes of the Meeting of the Court of Directors held on 17 September 2026
items.summary: The Bank's Court of Directors acts as a unitary board, setting the organisation's strategy and budget and taking key decisions on resourcing and appointments. Required to meet a minimum seven times per year, it has five executive members from the Bank and up to nine non-executive members.
items.why: deterministic: corroborated across feeds

items.title: Regulators unveil plans to simplify Senior Manager and Certification Regime
items.summary: The number of financial services roles required to face enhanced checks from regulators will fall significantly under proposals that will support growth.
items.why: Major regulatory proposal significantly scaling back certification requirements for financial roles.

items.title: Ripple secures national bank charter; inks deals with BNY and Robinhood
items.summary: Digital asset infrastructure firm Ripple has been granted approval to establish a national trust bank and struck separate partnerships agreements with BNY and Robinhood.
items.why: Ripple secures OCC approval for a national trust bank charter alongside major institutional deals.

items.title: Bank of Canada raises the policy rate by 25 basis points to 2½%
items.summary: The Bank of Canada today increased its target for the overnight rate by 25 basis points to 2.5%, with the Bank Rate at 2.75% and the deposit rate at 2.45%.
items.why: Bank of Canada raises policy rate by 25 basis points.

items.title: Bank of England sets out approach to tokenised collateral in central clearing
items.summary: The Bank of England has today launched a consultation supporting central counterparties (CCPs) acceptance of tokenised forms of eligible collateral.
items.why: New Bank of England consultation on accepting tokenised collateral in central clearing.

items.title: Federal Reserve Board requests public comment on two proposals related to establishing a regulatory framework for Board-supervised payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act
items.summary: Federal Reserve Board requests public comment on two proposals related to establishing a regulatory framework for Board-supervised payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act
items.why: New rule proposals establishing a regulatory framework for Fed-supervised payment stablecoin issuers.

items.title: Ripple gets OCC’s unconditional charter approval
items.summary: figure div img src="https://imgproxy.divecdn.com/xzzDxWGLCdEGAklAphCI2_9BbX1F1ojLMnbOXu1OJ4c/g:ce/rs:fill:1600:900:1/Z3M6Ly9kaXZlc2l0ZS1zdG9yYWdlL2RpdmVpbWFnZS9HZXR0eUltYWdlcy05NTExNjU3NjIuanBn.webp"/ /div /figure p The fintech is building on its charter victory by announcing expanded partnerships with BNY and Robinhood. /p
items.why: Major crypto firm receives unconditional OCC approval for a national bank charter.

items.title: UK and EU financial regulators seek answers from Google over cloud outage
items.summary: The European Banking Authority and the UK's Financial Conduct Authority have been in contact with Google over the major cloud outage earlier this week that knocked out several bank websites.
items.why: Joint regulatory inquiry by UK and EU authorities into Google over a major cloud outage.

items.title: SoFi launches tokenised deposits
items.summary: SoFi Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ: SOFI), the everything app for digital financial services, today announced the launch of SoFi Earn (SOFIE), the first and only national bank-issued tokenized deposit for consumers.
items.why: First national bank-issued tokenised deposit for consumers launched by SoFi.

items.title: HSBC launches first stablecoin
items.summary: Global bank HSBC has launched RedCoin, its first stablecoin, for public use.
items.why: Major global bank launches its first public stablecoin, marking significant digital asset expansion.

items.title: Thailand and Malaysia back Singapore's BLOOM cross-border digital money initiative
items.summary: The central banks Thailand and Malaysia are backing a Monetary Authority of Singapore-led public-private sector initiative to advance cross-border settlement in digital money.
items.why: Central bank support for cross-border digital money initiative marks significant monetary tech policy expansion.

items.title: Riksbank reignites e-krona debate
items.summary: With cash usage down, a digital euro on the horizon and stablecoins gathering momentum, Sweden's central bank has reignited a debate on whether the country should roll out its own e-krona.
items.why: Central bank reopens sovereign digital currency debate amid cash decline and digital euro developments.

items.title: Revolut launches personal loans in the UK
items.summary: Revolut is stepping up its challenge to the UK's high street banks with the introduction of a personal loan product.
items.why: Revolut expands into UK consumer lending with the launch of personal loans.

items.title: Japan tells banks to review cyber policies following wave of attacks
items.summary: Japan is drafting an emergency cybersecurity policy package and telling banks to review their own policies in response to a wave of hacks.
items.why: Japan drafting emergency cybersecurity regulatory package instructing banks to review policies following attacks.

items.title: Canada opens stablecoin consultation
items.summary: The Canadian government has kicked off a 60-day public consultation on draft stablecoin regulations that would maintain a ban on yield payments.
items.why: Canada launched a public consultation on new draft stablecoin regulations.

items.title: Bank of England orders review of Revolut product approvals - FT
items.summary: The Bank of England has instigated a review into how Revolut's product approval process works, according to the Financial Times.
items.why: Bank of England ordering a review into Revolut's product approvals represents significant regulatory scrutiny.

items.title: Sezzle applies for national bank charter
items.summary: Sezzle Inc. (NASDAQ: SEZL) (Sezzle or Company) today announced that it has filed an application with the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) to charter a national bank, Sezzle Bank, N.A. and applied to the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) for deposit insurance.
items.why: BNPL provider Sezzle formally applies to OCC for a national bank charter.

items.title: Coinbase says customer contact data exposed in third-party breach
items.summary: Crypto exchange Coinbase says a security incident at a third-party vendor exposed some customer contact data but that its own systems were not breached.
items.why: Customer contact data exposed in third-party security breach at Coinbase.

items.title: UK Government takes on till fraud with POS software standards
items.summary: The UK government is introducing mandatory software standards for point-of-sale systems in an effort to clamp down on till fraud.
items.why: New government regulation introducing mandatory POS software standards to curb till fraud.

items.title: Firms object to shares being part of OKX-ICE tokenised stock trading venture
items.summary: A host of companies, including JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs and Microsoft, have registered their objection to their shares trading on a planned tokenised platform developed by Nyse parent Intercontinental Exchange and crypto exchange OKX.
items.why: Major corporations formally object to tokenised stock trading platform, creating significant industry conflict.

items.title: Crypto exchange HTX to leave UK after FCA lawsuit
items.summary: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority has secured a High Court order preventing crypto exchange HTX from ‌knowingly promoting cryptoasset services unlawfully to customers in the country.
items.why: Regulatory enforcement action and court order forcing crypto exchange HTX out of the UK.

items.title: Exclusive: Revolut customers hit by fresh security breach
items.why: Exclusive report of a fresh security breach affecting customers at major fintech Revolut.

items.title: Australia's second largest veggie company admits 'cartel conduct'
items.summary: Perfection Fresh Australia has admitted fixing the price of broccoli, cauliflower and lettuce sold to Aldi stores in New South Wales.
items.why: Major producer admits illegal price-fixing cartel conduct in supermarket supply chain.

items.title: L2 Capital Picks Newton to Tokenize $500m Pre-IPO AI Shares
items.summary: The Hong Kong investment firm will use Newton Labs' compliance protocol to put late-stage private technology holdings onchain for eligible investors. The post L2 Capital Picks Newton to Tokenize $500m Pre-IPO AI Shares appeared first on The Fintech Times .
items.why: Major fintech deal tokenizing $500m of late-stage private AI equity.

items.title: Revolut faces Bank of England scrutiny over product approval process, reports say
items.why: Bank of England scrutiny of a major fintech's product approvals is a key regulatory development.

items.title: Inflation surges more than expected ahead of RBA meeting
items.summary: Australia's inflation rate picked up more than expected in September, increasing expectations of an interest rate hike next week.
items.why: Surprising CPI data beat shifting RBA monetary policy and interest rate expectations.

items.title: Star Casino fined $260m for money laundering violations
items.summary: Australia's financial intelligence agency, AUSTRAC, had sought a much steeper fine that could have forced the casino company into financial collapse.
items.why: Major regulatory enforcement penalty of $260m by AUSTRAC for AML violations.

items.title: Victorian caravan maker Essential Caravans enters voluntary administration
items.summary: The Victorian manufacturer joins a string of caravan companies to have collapsed amid financial pressure in recent years.
items.why: Insolvency of a notable manufacturer amid economic pressures.

items.title: Chalmers lowers expectations for fuel discounts after high inflation result
items.summary: Faced with another high inflation result and the likelihood of a rate hike next Tuesday, Treasurer Jim Chalmers calls for "perspective" and points to external factors.
items.why: Treasurer adjusting expectations ahead of a likely rate hike.

items.title: Corporate watchdog looking into failed Firmus float – as it happened
items.summary: Appearing before a Senate estimates hearing, Australian Securities and Investments Commission chief Sarah Court sheds some light on the alleged shenanigans behind the great $44 billion float flop.
items.why: ASIC reveals scrutiny into major $44 billion failed float at Senate estimates.
